name: 53037 · Jackson, WI
findings: ZIP 53037 (Jackson) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53037 (Jackson) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 53037 (Jackson) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
